text:
alex: quick async standup — paste a 1-2 line update (yesterday / blocker / today). flag any SLO or alert follow-ups.

maria: yesterday: rolled out error_rate threshold tweak for /generate in staging. blocker: sporadic 500s on dedupe job still showing up. today: add extra logging + trace the dedupe worker restarts. ping @jamal if you can spare cycles. :thinking_face:

jamal: yesterday: rotated instance profiles for dedicated pools. blocker: prometheus relabeler change removed kv_cache hit_ratio metrics around 02:00. losing that metric blocks some SLO dashboards. today: reapply relabel rule and cut a hotfix. ETA ~2h.

li: yesterday: handover + triaged two high-latency alerts in eu-west. blocker: can't repro tail latency locally; traces sparse. today: collect trace samples, try traffic replay on staging. @alex can you bump sampling rate for 30m? :eyes:

oncall-bot: [12:34] Paging update: high-latency-us-west incident resolved. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/reliability/latency 

alex: noted. jamal — can you paste the relabeler diff here? if it's small I can cut the patch and roll. also we'll want an eval that asserts kv_cache metric presence.

jamal: here is the relabeler snippet I tested:
```yaml
- source_labels: [__name__]
  regex: 'kv_cache_hit_ratio'
  action: keep
```
I'll push the full change to infra-config and open #3456 for the hotfix.

maria: filed ticket 2345 for dedupe logging and linked traces. adding a slack alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 15m.

li: small ask: can someone review my PR #789 (adds tracing tag for request.split_id)? no functional change, just tagging.

alex: I'll review in ~20m. quick FYI: embeddings endpoint SLO burn bumped to 1.3% this morning (baseline 0.8%). looks correlated with bursty traffic but worth monitoring — opening follow-up.

maria: I can add a short alert: embeddings SLO > 1% sustained for 30m -> notify eng-sre.

jamal: hotfix ticket created: #3456, will attach relabel diff and rollback steps.

alex: great. if no urgent follow-ups, we'll do the same async check tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
